thread:
maya: Quick docs PR for SOC2 wording around audit logs, retention, and PII handling  PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/849
lex: Skimmed. Two things: specify default retention instead of vague language, and clarify KMS/encryption comments so it doesn't imply keys are stored with logs.
elena: Legal prefers explicit numbers. Suggest: 'Default retention: 90 days; enterprise extensions available via contract (up to 7 years).'
maya: Added that wording to the PR with this sentence: "Audit logs are retained for 90 days by default; customers on Enterprise plans may request extended retention up to 7 years via contract amendment."
sam: Small technical correction: we don't always redact PII before any processing. We run automated PII detection at ingestion and mask before long-term storage; transient in-memory text may contain raw tokens for processing. Need to avoid implying pre-ingest perfect redaction.
lex: Good catch. How about: "Automated PII detection and masking are applied during ingestion; detected PII is redacted prior to long-term storage. Access controls and encryption protect transient data and edge cases."
maya: Updated PR text to that. I also added an SDK snippet showing how to opt out of audit logging for ephemeral workloads:
```js
// disable audit logging for ephemeral local runs
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, options: { enableAuditLogging: false } });
```
lex: Can we include a Dedicated migration note? Ops console retention might differ; link to /dedicated/retention-config.md.
elena: Also add a short auditor-access process: request via support ticket + SOW, time-limited, and all auditor actions are logged.
maya: Added bullet: "Auditor access is granted via documented request (support ticket + SOW) and is time-limited; auditor activity is recorded in the audit stream."
sam: One more nit: don't use just 'HSM' generically. Mention KMS/HSM integration where applicable and that hosted keys are managed by Redwood unless a customer-managed-key contract is in place.
maya: Revised to: "Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported for Private deployments; for Hosted deployments, keys are managed by Redwood unless otherwise contracted."
lex: Running linter then will approve. :thumbsup:
doc-bot: docs-ci: lint passed for PR #849  2 warnings (frontmatter fields unused).
maya: I'll address warnings in a small follow-up commit, then merge once legal confirms retention numbers tomorrow. Thanks!
elena: Noted for legal review.
lex: This reads much clearer now, thanks everyone.
